mapper.sql: id, tenant_id, visitor_id, website_session_id, display_name, email, mobile_phone, whatsapp, contact_id, lead_id, user_agent, first_seen_at, last_seen_at, create_time, update_time
mapper.select: SELECT FROM crm_webchat_visitor WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND visitor_id = #{visitorId} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO crm_webchat_visitor ( tenant_id, visitor_id, website_session_id, display_name, email, mobile_phone, whatsapp, contact_id, lead_id, user_agent, first_seen_at, last_seen_at, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{tenantId}, #{visitorId}, #{websiteSessionId}, #{displayName}, #{email}, #{mobilePhone}, #{whatsapp}, #{contactId}, #{leadId}, #{userAgent}, COALESCE(#{firstSeenAt}, now()), COALESCE(#{lastSeenAt}, now()), COALESCE(#{createTime}, now()), #{updateTime} ) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, visitor_id) DO UPDATE SET website_session_id = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.website_session_id, crm_webchat_visitor.website_session_id), user_agent = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.user_agent, crm_webchat_visitor.user_agent), last_seen_at = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.last_seen_at, now()), update_time = now()
mapper.update: UPDATE crm_webchat_visitor SET display_name = COALESCE(#{displayName}, display_name), email = COALESCE(#{email}, email), mobile_phone = COALESCE(#{mobilePhone}, mobile_phone), whatsapp = COALESCE(#{whatsapp}, whatsapp), website_session_id = COALESCE(#{websiteSessionId}, website_session_id), user_agent = COALESCE(#{userAgent}, user_agent), last_seen_at = COALESCE(#{lastSeenAt}, now()), update_time = now() WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND visitor_id = #{visitorId}
UPDATE crm_webchat_visitor SET contact_id = #{contactId}, lead_id = #{leadId}, update_time = now() WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND visitor_id = #{visitorId}
UPDATE crm_webchat_visitor SET contact_id = #{newContactId}, lead_id = NULL, update_time = now() WHERE lead_id = #{oldLeadId}
